legalName: Motion for Belated Determination and Set-Aside Under AS 12.55.085(e)
boundReferenceRole: none — this family composes from committed records; no official binary is bound and none is included
routeSelectionNote: One route, one instrument set: every component belongs to the single AS 12.55.085(e) belated set-aside route, and the motion states its statutory basis in its own title and body. No election control exists on any composed page and no route choice is left to the participant.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date probation was discharged, from the discharge order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date probation was discharged, from the discharge order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date probation was discharged, copied from the discharge order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Offense in this case, worded exactly as the judgment words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Offense in this case, worded exactly as the judgment words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offense fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offense, worded exactly as the judgment words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Original criminal case number in the caption of the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Original criminal case number in the caption of the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the original criminal case, copied from the judgment or the discharge order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption - the court that sentenced you in the original criminal case, and its location
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption - the court that sentenced you in the original criminal case, and its location
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the original case lives in the sentencing court's file, and which court that is belongs to the participant's record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and location of the court that sentenced you - the office of that court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the order suspending imposition of sentence, from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the order suspending imposition of sentence, from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the SIS order, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement addressing the exclusions in AS 12.55.085(f)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement addressing the exclusions in AS 12.55.085(f)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: whether an offense falls within the (f) exclusions is an assertion the platform cannot make for the participant
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand statement addressing the AS 12.55.085(f) exclusions - if you believe the offense may fall within them, stop and get legal help instead of filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of compliance and rehabilitation as of the date probation was discharged
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of compliance and rehabilitation as of the date probation was discharged
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the participant's own account and asserts nothing about compliance or rehabilitation
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of compliance and rehabilitation as of the discharge date

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: List of the evidence you attach in support
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: List of the evidence you attach in support
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what evidence exists is a fact of the participant's own records, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: a list of the evidence you attach - the route contract names evidence concerning compliance and rehabilitation as of discharge as a component, and what to include is yours to decide

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office served
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office served
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the prosecuting office and the participant writes it before service
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney's office for the original case - the office of the sentencing court can give it to you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Original criminal case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Original criminal case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same original criminal case number you wrote in the motion's caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, and its location
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, and its location
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the proposed order travels with the motion and carries the same caption the participant establishes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court name and location you wrote in the motion's caption
